destination.name: Ahmedabad
destination.description: Ahmedabad has historic Hindu, Islamic and Jain monuments and traditional neighbourhoods known as pols. Its visitor sites include Gandhi Ashram and museums.

rows.name: Sarkhej Roza
rows.best_time_note: A commercial walking-tour listing explicitly says its Sarkhej Roza tour is not wheelchair accessible. This does not establish accessibility of every part of the monument; confirm an appropriate entrance and route with the site.
rows.description: Sarkhej Roza is a mosque, tomb and palace complex associated with the Sufi saint Ahmed Khattu Ganj Baksh. Historic buildings surround a large tank.
rows.source: Gujarat Tourism Official 2026

rows.name: Adalaj Ni Vav Stepwell
rows.description: Adalaj's five-storey stepwell was commissioned by Queen Rudabai in 1499. Carved pillars and walls surround the descent to the well.
rows.source: Gujarat Tourism Official 2026

rows.name: Calico Textile Museum
rows.best_time_note: Haveli guided tour 10:30â€“12:30, entry 10:15â€“10:30. Pre-registration required; closed Mondays and public holidays. Separate Chauk tour 14:30â€“16:30.
rows.description: The Sarabhai Foundation's Calico Museum displays textiles and collections of Indian art in Ahmedabad's Shahibaug area.
rows.source: Gujarat Tourism Official 2026

rows.name: Sidi Saiyyed Mosque & Old Pols
rows.description: Sidi Saiyyed Mosque near Khanpur Gate is known for carved stone screens. The existing record also groups the old-city pol neighbourhoods with this mosque.
rows.source: Google Maps 2026

rows.name: Kankaria Lake
rows.best_time_note: AMC budget2022-23 documents wheelchairs at each entry point. This verifies a facility, not step-free access to every ride or zone. General daytime admission INR25 is corroborated by2026 travel guides; confirm current gate tariff. Monday closure and separate ride charges apply.
rows.description: Kankaria is a historic Ahmedabad lake surrounding the island garden of Nagina Wadi. The lakefront has recreation facilities, with a zoo and aquarium nearby.
rows.source: Google Maps 2026

rows.name: Sabarmati Ashram
rows.best_time_note: Open daily, including public holidays. Hridaykunj interior is temporarily closed for conservation; view from outside.
rows.description: Gandhi's former ashram on the Sabarmati river contains a memorial museum and preserved buildings associated with his life.
rows.source: Gujarat Tourism Official 2026

rows.name: Lemon Tree Premier
rows.location: Off Nehru Bridge, Sabarmati River Front, Ahmedabad 380001, Gujarat
rows.description: Lemon Tree Premier, The Atrium, is beside the Sabarmati riverfront near Nehru Bridge in Ahmedabad.
rows.source: MakeMyTrip 2026

rows.name: The House of MG
rows.location: Opposite Sidi Saiyad Jali, Lal Darwaja, Ahmedabad 380001, Gujarat
rows.description: The House of MG occupies an early twentieth-century mansion with courtyards and verandahs. Facilities include Agashiye restaurant, an indoor pool, spa and fitness room.
rows.source: Booking.com 2026

rows.name: French Haveli Heritage Stay
rows.location: 1824 Khija Sheri, Dhal Ni Pol, opposite Jain temple, Ahmedabad 380001
rows.description: French Haveli is a restored Gujarati heritage home in Ahmedabad's old-city pol neighbourhoods. Rooms occupy several floors; the property has no car parking and the final 100 metres are reached on foot or by rickshaw.
rows.source: Booking.com 2026

rows.name: Vishalla Village Restaurant
rows.location: Opposite APMC Market, Vishalla Circle, Ahmedabad 380055
rows.source: Google Maps 2026

rows.name: Agashiye Terrace Restaurant
rows.location: The House of MG, opposite Sidi Saiyed Mosque, Lal Darwaja, Ahmedabad
rows.source: Eazydiner 2026

rows.name: Chandravilas Dining Hall
rows.location: 3114, near Ratan Pole, Gandhi Road, Manek Chowk, Ahmedabad
rows.source: Google Maps 2026

destination.name: Champaner
destination.description: Champaner and Pavagadh form a UNESCO World Heritage archaeological landscape containing fortifications, temples, mosques and historic water structures. Champaner preserves remains of the Gujarat Sultanate's former capital.

rows.name: Jami Masjid, Champaner
rows.entry_fee: INR35 Indian online group-of-monuments ticket; INR40 counter ticket; shared pass conditions apply
rows.best_time_note: Visit duration is the midpoint of published 1-2 hours. An older government report documents accessibility funding, not completion; wheelchair status remains unknown. Admission is a shared monument pass, which the current per-attraction budget schema cannot fully model.
rows.description: Jami Masjid is a monumental mosque at Champaner, with carved pillars, minarets, a courtyard and stone screens.
rows.source: Gujarat Tourism; Google Maps; published visitor guides

rows.name: Kevada Masjid
rows.entry_fee: Shared Champaner monument pass; separate current charge unverified
rows.best_time_note: One hour is the lower end of a published 1-2 hour visit recommendation. Shared-pass pricing and conflicting separate-charge reports cannot be represented reliably as an independent fee; numeric admission remains unknown. Wheelchair access unverified.
rows.description: Kevada Masjid is a mosque monument north of Champaner's citadel, accompanied by a separate cenotaph.
rows.source: Gujarat Tourism; Google Maps; TravelSetu

rows.name: Champaner Heritage Resort
rows.location: Village Bhamaria, off Champaner-Jambughoda Road, Gujarat 389360
rows.description: Champaner Heritage Resort provides heritage-style rooms and suites, a restaurant, pool and garden grounds in Bhamaria near Champaner.
rows.source: Official resort; Gujarat Tourism; Google Maps Yatra quote

rows.location: Baska, Halol-Vadodara Road, Halol, Gujarat 389350
rows.source: MakeMyTrip destination dining guide; Google Maps; Restaurant Guru

destination.name: Dwarka
destination.description: Dwarka is a coastal pilgrimage town associated with Krishna. Its principal sites include the Dwarkadhish temple, Rukmini temple and Nageshwar Jyotirlinga, with Bet Dwarka offshore near Okha.

rows.name: Dwarkadhish Temple
rows.best_time_note: Darshan has a midday closure; published guide gives 06:30-13:00 and 17:00-21:30. Accessibility guide reports assisted entry via the exit side and a step near the sanctum; independent wheelchair access is not established.
rows.description: The Dwarkadhish temple is a Krishna pilgrimage shrine in Dwarka, also known as Jagat Mandir.
rows.source: Gujarat Tourism Official 2026

rows.name: Nageshwar Jyotirlinga
rows.best_time_note: Accessibility guide reports rear entrance access and steep ramps requiring assistance. Wheelchair darshan is from an elevated area with restricted sightlines; direct access to the Jyotirlinga is unavailable.
rows.description: Nageshwar is a Shiva temple in the Dwarka area, traditionally counted among the twelve Jyotirlingas.
rows.source: Gujarat Tourism Official 2026

rows.name: Bet Dwarka
rows.entry_fee: Free general temple admission; transport and optional services extra
rows.best_time_note: Road access is available over Sudarshan Setu, inaugurated in February 2024. Ferry is optional; no verified current ferry tariff is stored. Temple hours vary and include a midday closure. Accessibility guide reports steps near the sanctum requiring lifting assistance.
rows.description: Bet Dwarka is an island near Okha associated with Krishna. This itinerary point is anchored at Shri Beyt Dwarkadhish Temple.
rows.source: Gujarat Tourism Official 2026

rows.name: Rukmini Devi Temple
rows.best_time_note: Disability travel guide reports steps and uneven paths preventing wheelchair access.
rows.description: The Rukmini temple near Dwarka is dedicated to Krishna's consort and features carved exterior walls.
rows.source: Gujarat Tourism Official 2026

rows.name: Hotel Darshan Palace
rows.location: Jalaram Road, near Laxmi Marble, Rampara, Ghanshyam Nagar, Dwarka 361335
rows.description: Hotel Darshan Palace is a Dwarka hotel on Jalaram Road. Booking listings describe air-conditioned rooms, private bathrooms, Wi-Fi and parking.
rows.source: Google Maps business listing; Booking.com; MakeMyTrip

rows.name: Toran Hotel Dwarka
rows.location: Near Circuit House, Civil Hospital Road, Dwarka, Gujarat
rows.description: Toran Tourist Bungalow is Gujarat Tourism accommodation near the Circuit House in Dwarka.
rows.source: Gujarat Tourism Official 2026

rows.location: Home Guard Chowk, Dwarka, Gujarat 361335
rows.source: Google Maps; Amit Gujarati on-location dining video

destination.name: Gir National Park
destination.location: Sasan Gir and Devalia visitor area, Gujarat
destination.best_time: Late November to early March (cool and dry season)
destination.description: The Gir landscape is habitat for the Asiatic lion. Visitors can book guided vehicle safaris from Sasan Gir or visit the separate Gir Interpretation Zone at Devalia.
destination.seasonal_note: Main jungle safari operates in seasonal slots; advance permits required. Devalia bus safari closes Wednesdays. This application does not enforce dated permit availability.

rows.name: Gir Jungle Safari (Sinh Sadan reporting point)
rows.entry_fee: Indian weekday six-seat Type B booking: permit800 + vehicle2000 + guide400 = INR3200; other dates/vehicles/nationalities differ
rows.best_time_note: Stored interval is the official 08:30-11:30 departure slot, not flexible admission. Report30 minutes early with permit and original ID. Other seasonal slots exist. Numeric cost covers one private Type B vehicle booking, not a per-person ticket. Current planner cannot enforce fixed departures or seasonal availability; confirm booking before relying on an itinerary.
rows.description: A permit-controlled guided vehicle safari through the Gir forest, reporting at Sinh Sadan in Sasan Gir.
rows.source: Gujarat Forest Department official booking terms; Google Maps

rows.name: Devalia Interpretation Zone Bus Safari
rows.entry_fee: Indian weekday bus ticket INR150; weekends/festivals INR190; foreign tariffs differ
rows.best_time_note: Official bus slots last30 minutes. Stored window is winter morning service; winter afternoon15:00-17:00 also operates. Summer schedules differ. Closed every Wednesday. Permit availability and exact departure must be checked separately; wheelchair boarding arrangements unverified.
rows.description: Devalia's Gir Interpretation Zone offers a short forest-department bus safari in a managed wildlife area.
rows.source: Gujarat Forest Department official bus booking page; Google Maps

rows.name: Anil Farms Gir Jungle Resort
rows.location: Bhalchhel, Mendarda, Sasan Gir, Gujarat 362135
rows.description: Anil Farms Gir Jungle Resort offers air-conditioned rooms on garden and mango-orchard grounds near Sasan Gir.
rows.source: Official resort website and official-site quote displayed on Google Maps

rows.name: Hotel Gir Kathiyawadi Sasan Gir
rows.location: Sasan-Talala Highway, Sasan Gir, Gujarat 362135
rows.source: Google Maps; Wanderlog dining guide; Restaurant Guru

destination.name: Modhera
destination.distance_from_ahmedabad: 99 km by road to Sun Temple (Gujarat Tourism)
destination.description: Modhera stands near the Pushpavati River in north Gujarat. Its principal monument is the Solanki-era Sun Temple, with a sculpted assembly hall and stepped reservoir; the village also contains the Modheshwari Mata shrine.

rows.name: Modheshwari Mata Temple
rows.best_time_note: One hour is the lower end of a published 1-2 hour visit recommendation. Published daily opening hours conflict; confirm with temple before travel. Accessibility unknown.
rows.description: This Modhera shrine is dedicated to Modheshwari, a form of Parvati or Durga revered by the Modh community.
rows.source: Gujarat Tourism; Google Maps; local tour operator visitor guide

rows.name: Modhera Sun Temple
rows.entry_fee: INR20 Indian online admission; foreign online ticket INR250; booking conditions apply
rows.best_time_note: Stored hours follow Gujarat Tourism's visitor brochure. Other sources describe sunrise to sunset. Two hours is a published visitor-duration recommendation, not a fixed tour. General wheelchair access remains unverified; entrance amenities do not establish access to stepped areas.
rows.description: The Sun Temple complex contains a carved shrine hall, an assembly hall and Surya Kund, a stepped reservoir lined with small shrines. It dates to the Solanki period.
rows.source: Gujarat Tourism; ASI ticketing listings; OpenStreetMap

rows.name: Modhera Sunrise Resort
rows.location: Behind the Sun Temple, Modhera, Gujarat 384412
rows.description: Modhera Sunrise Resort offers accommodation including traditional-style bhungas and tents near the Sun Temple, with a pool and dining facilities.
rows.source: Official resort website; Google Maps Cleartrip quote

rows.name: Eulogia Restro Cafe, Sun Temple Modhera
rows.location: Sun Temple, Modhera, Gujarat 384412
rows.source: Google Maps business listing; Restaurant Guru

destination.name: Rann of Kutch
destination.location: Dhordo and the Great Rann visitor area, Kutch, Gujarat
destination.image_alt: Kalo Dungar (The Black Hills) - Gujarat Tourism
destination.description: The Great Rann is a seasonal salt landscape in northern Kutch. Dhordo provides access to the White Rann, while Kalo Dungar offers elevated views over the surrounding region.
destination.seasonal_note: The white salt surface depends on weather and water conditions; monsoon conditions can change access and appearance. Permit requirements apply.

rows.name: Kalo Dungar
rows.entry_fee: No viewpoint admission charge; local transport/parking and applicable permits separate
rows.best_time_note: Published visit guidance suggests1-2 hours. IRCTC notes over1km uphill from bus parking and limited local transfer options; wheelchair access to the final viewpoint is unverified. Road routes are approach routes, not proof of step-free summit access.
rows.image_alt: Kalo Dungar (The Black Hills) - Gujarat Tourism
rows.description: Kalo Dungar is Kutch's highest hill, with views across the Great Rann and a Dattatreya temple near the summit.
rows.source: Gujarat Tourism; OpenStreetMap; IRCTC; regional guide

rows.name: White Rann near Dhordo
rows.entry_fee: Published adult White Rann permit INR100; vehicle permit and optional activities extra; confirm current permit tariff
rows.best_time_note: A local published day plan allocates16:30-19:00 before dinner; stored2.5 hours is that visit allowance, not opening hours. Accessibility guide reports assisted access at the viewing area but uneven salt crust beyond it. Do not infer independent wheelchair access across the flats. Permit/seasonal access must be checked.
rows.description: The White Rann near Dhordo is a seasonal salt-flat viewing destination, commonly visited around sunset and full-moon periods.
rows.source: Gujarat Tourism; Google Maps; local operators

rows.location: Dhordo village, Gorewali Post, Bhuj taluka, Kutch370510
rows.description: Gateway to Rann Resort offers air-conditioned bhunga accommodation at Dhordo, with meals and a cultural programme included in published room packages.
rows.source: Official resort booking tariff; Google Maps

destination.name: Saputara
destination.description: Saputara is a hill town in the Sahyadri range in southern Gujarat. Its lake, hill viewpoints and museum introduce visitors to the landscape and culture of the Dangs.
destination.seasonal_note: Check weather and local access before visiting hill viewpoints. Museum reopening has not been confirmed.

destination.name: Somnath
destination.image_alt: Shree Somnath Jyotirlinga Temple - Gujarat Tourism
destination.description: Somnath, also known as Prabhas Patan, is a coastal pilgrimage destination near Veraval. Visitors come to the Somnath Jyotirlinga temple and nearby sites associated with Krishna.

rows.name: Bhalka Tirth
rows.description: Bhalka Tirth commemorates the traditional account of Krishna being struck by a hunter's arrow near Prabhas Patan.

rows.name: Somnath Temple

rows.image_alt: Shree Somnath Jyotirlinga Temple - Gujarat Tourism

rows.name: Triveni Sangam

rows.description: Triveni Sangam is the pilgrimage ghat where the Hiran, Kapila and Saraswati rivers are traditionally identified as meeting the Arabian Sea.
rows.source: Gujarat Tourism Official 2026
